title: Lakebase storage quota default increased to 32 TB
body: The default database storage quota for Lakebase is now 32 TB, up from 16 TB. The new quota takes effect the next time a compute starts or restarts. A compute that is already running keeps the previous quota until its next restart. Quotas larger than 32 TB are available on request from Databricks Support. See [Manage projects](/aws/en/oltp/projects/manage-projects).
